title: COMO SCORED NINE AWAY FROM HOME IN THE CHAMPIONS LEAGUE. NINE!
description:
First European season. Nine goals away from home. Lens got one.

Como won 9-1 at Lens, and no team has ever scored more away from home in Champions League history. Tasos Douvikas grabbed a hat-trick. Nico Paz added a goal and two assists, which is three goals' worth of work for one man.

It gets better. Nine goals ties Bayern's record for a single Champions League match, and the eight-goal margin ties Liverpool's 8-0 win over Besiktas in 2007. Two records, one night.

Cesc Fabregas, meanwhile, told his players not to believe their own hype. Fourth in Serie A is quite a lot of hype to ignore.

Is Fabregas right to keep a lid on it, or has Como earned a bit of noise? Be loud in the comments.
